description: Covers only what Dependabot cannot: the job container image and the cosign release pin. Dependabot owns the `uses:` actions, so only custom.regex is enabled.
Updates target dev, run weekly, and are quarantined for 7 days. Nothing automerges; majors need approval on the Dependency Dashboard.

customManagers.description: debian:trixie-slim@<digest> wherever it is pinned: the job containers in the workflows, the digest comment in container.yml, and the two container commands in README.md. tests/container.sh fails if these differ, so a bump must change all of them in one PR (digest-only bumps).
cosign release passed to sigstore/cosign-installer in release.yml.

packageRules.description: One PR for the container image, pinned in several workflow files. Docker digest updates carry no release timestamp, so this rule alone tolerates a missing one (otherwise they would stay pending forever); the 7-day age is still enforced whenever a timestamp exists.
Never propose pre-release builds. The age setting mirrors the top-level 7 days (kept because scanners read only packageRules).
